intent: Month grid for picking one date or showing a date range.
useWhen: Booking, scheduling, or choosing a single calendar day
Highlighting a start and end on the month grid
doNotUseWhen: A typed date field without a grid — use DatePicker
A form date field — use DatePicker
A schedule of events (month/week/day/list) — not this Calendar

value.note: controlled YYYY-MM-DD. Default is one selected day.

onValueChange.note: (date: string) => void // ISO date. With start/end this is the clicked day; DatePicker range sets start then end.

start.note: YYYY-MM-DD range start. When set without end, that day is selected.

end.note: YYYY-MM-DD range end. When both start and end are set, days between are in-range.

requirements: Heading names the visible month and uses aria-live polite
Previous and next month controls have aria-labels
Today is announced in the day accessible name
Range start and end are named in the day accessible name; days between are in-range and aria-selected
Keyboard arrows move day focus (roving tabindex)

doNot: Do not invent a local calendar or DualCalendar
Do not use Calendar as a form field — use DatePicker
Do not turn Calendar into an event or schedule calendar
Do not replace nav with custom icon buttons — use kit Buttons
snippet:
<Calendar size="md" defaultValue="2026-08-29" onValueChange={(date) => setDate(date)} />
<Calendar start="2026-08-10" end="2026-08-18" />
